description: This file contains an extension to the ProcessInfo class, adding computed properties and static methods to determine environment-specific states such as whether the app is running in preview mode, nix mode, or running tests. It also includes logic to resolve nix mode based on environment variables, user defaults, and bundle information.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: A class in Foundation framework providing process-related information.

methods.name: isPreview
methods.description: Determines if the process is running in Xcode previews by checking an environment variable.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: Static method to determine if nix mode should be enabled based on environment variables, user defaults, and app bundle status.

methods.name: isNixMode
methods.description: Computed property to check if nix mode is active based on environment and user defaults.

methods.name: isRunningTests
methods.description: Determines if the current process is running test bundles, either via loaded bundles or environment variables.
